title: private-deployment-horizon-weekly-sync-2026-06-29
body:
Weekly sync prep (Horizon private deployment) - 2026-06-29
Owner: Marcus Lee (notes + facilitator)
Attendees (expected): Marcus Lee, Priya Shah (SE), Diego Alvarez (Infra), Emma Chen (Ops), Jordan Patel (Horizon PM), Horizon infra lead TBD, SRE on-call Alex Kim

Agenda (30 min):
- Quick status (5m) - Marcus
- Network/VPC progress + peering validation (5m) - Diego
- Installer/image + on-prem resource validation (5m) - Priya
- Security: certs, KMS/HSM, SAML (5m) - Emma
- Performance baseline plan + smoke tests (5m) - Marcus/Emma
- Blockers + owners + next steps (5m)

Notes / context (scratchpad):
- Goal this sprint: complete VPC peering and baseline perf tests so we can flip staging -> canary next week (target 2026-07-06).
- Horizon asked for tighter SLOs; confirm canary QPS and latency targets before run. Jordan requested 99th pct < 1200ms for inference at 1 token per request average - need to validate with smoke.
- Installer image: rc-2026-06-24 published to GH. Priya to confirm Horizon can run installer in their air-gapped environment (air-gap package host prepared).
- KMS/HSM: Horizon will use their KMS in AWS account (customer-managed). Emma to confirm key policy and test encrypt/decrypt with staging key.

Milestones / timeline (high-level):
- Network + firewall rules configured (in progress) - target 2026-06-30
- Installer validated in Horizon lab (air-gapped) - target 2026-07-02
- Perf baseline smoke tests complete (internal) - target 2026-07-04
- Canary rollout staging -> canary (customer-visible) - target 2026-07-06

Blockers (current):
1) Firewall rules / IP allowlist not finalized on Horizon side (BLOCKER)
   - Impact: cannot complete VPC peering validation or run end-to-end installer tests
   - Owner: Jordan Patel (Horizon) + Diego (network validation)
   - Next step: Diego to provide exact IP ranges and ports to Horizon by EOD 2026-06-29
   - Ticket: JIRA PD-324

2) Missing SAML metadata for SSO (medium)
   - Impact: Console login flows failing in staging for Horizon engineers; not blocker for inference rollout but needed for admin ops
   - Owner: Emma (ops) to coordinate with Horizon IAM
   - Next step: Emma to request metadata and test in staging by 2026-07-01
   - Ticket: JIRA PD-330

3) Installer logging to local NFS failing in air-gapped run (low/urgent)
   - Impact: logs not persisted; hinders debugging during tests
   - Owner: Priya + Horizon infra lead
   - Next step: Priya to push debug build with verbose logging and short-run repro script by 2026-06-30 (GH PR reference repo/horizon-deploy-installer#12)

Open questions (to bring up in sync):
- Pin to model v1.2.0 for the canary, or use v1.2.x-latest? (risk: bit rot + perf variance)
- Horizon requested GPU pinning per node; confirm topology with on-prem team (which nodes will have A100s vs T4s)
- Audit/log retention policy: Horizon asked for 1 year retention on audit logs; check storage sizing and costs

Action items (owner / due):
- Diego: provide IP ranges / port list + sample iptables snippet to Horizon (due 2026-06-29) [BLOCKER] (PD-324)
- Emma: request SAML metadata from Horizon + validate SSO in staging (due 2026-07-01) (PD-330)
- Priya: publish debug installer build and repro script to GH, coordinate air-gap transfer with Horizon (due 2026-06-30)
- Marcus: prepare perf smoke test plan (script, sample load, expected baselines) and share with team + Horizon (due 2026-06-30)
- Jordan (Horizon): confirm rack/network maintenance window for canary (due 2026-07-01)
- Alex Kim (SRE): create runbook checklist for canary rollback (due 2026-07-03)

Prep notes for meeting:
- Bring JIRA links PD-324 and PD-330 to point at specific logs/errors
- Have perf script ready locally to demo one quick smoke (5-10 reqs) if network allows
- Ask Horizon for one on-call escalation phone number for canary period

Quick decisions we can make in sync if ready:
- Agree to pin model to v1.2.0 for canary (if Horizon agrees)
- Approve short maintenance window for canary (30-60m)

Misc / miscellaneous scratch items:
- License agreement addendum for on-prem (legal reviewing) - expect to finish 2026-07-08, could block final install if not signed
- Cost estimate: Emma to send updated storage + egress estimate for 1yr audit retention after runbook confirmed

Follow-up / next meeting:
- If blockers cleared, schedule 30m canary kickoff meeting on 2026-07-06 morning (tentative)
- Otherwise, next weekly sync 2026-07-06 to re-evaluate

End scratchpad.

(Notation: rough notes + TODO list; will tidy into a short agenda to send to Jordan before the call)
